claims.description: The exhaustive guard discovers every production route-entry consent assertion, requires exactly one classified owner, prevents route-over-gating on service-owned mixed routes, and preserves the under-gating gate-before-dispatch guard.
The existing fail-closed control for an unknown future service discriminant remains in the focused regression set; none of the three sibling service contracts adds a discriminant.
The mutation record contains tests-before-code red, candidate green, production-revert red, exact restore green, repeated commands, case names, exit codes, and failure parity.
Summary submission returns the saved idempotent result after withdrawal and rejects new evaluation before the LLM dependency.
Summary retry returns available and no-claim deterministic outcomes after withdrawal, while an acquired claim rejects before evaluation and is released.
Recall Bridge returns every named empty deterministic result after withdrawal and rejects the LLM-ready path before provider dispatch.
The session route harness proves deterministic delegation without a route-entry gate and maps service-owned refusal to CONSENT_WITHDRAWN.
The implementation plan accurately records the completed original and Rework 2 repository work and points to the Rework 2 evidence directory.

The manifest explicitly classifies all remaining request-time route assertions, including four independently deliverable mixed-route residues, so a new or unowned route assertion fails the structural guard.
The exact completion summary uses resolvable file and line pointers and records clean attributable standard verification plus bounded residue.
